Guides / Battle & team / Held items

Held items

All 25 held items, what they do and where to get them.

One held item per Pokémon, given from the Party & PC tab. Stat items change its numbers; the rest act during fights. Role items push one step of the squad loop and work from the bench too.

Held items work in battles you fight yourself too (manual battles and manual Tower floors), not only in auto fights: Leftovers, Shell Bell, Life Orb, Rocky Helmet, Loaded Dice and Focus Sash act every turn, and your lead's Metronome and Light Clay count. Effects tied to boss shields or the bench only matter where those exist.

Where to get them

  • The Mart: plain items from 1 badge, role items from 2 badges, Leader items (King's Rock, Metronome) from 3 badges.
  • Bosses drop a random held item 40% of the time (Dynamax and Gigantamax bosses always).
  • First Gym wins include a random held item (never an Everstone).
  • The Mart buys held items back for a quarter of their price.
